name: create-from-prompt
title: Create From Prompt
description: The "Describe it. We'll build the first draft." page: an address field with availability, a description, template chips, a model Select with a cost hint and a Generate button, plus a progress card with a step list, times and a streaming Writing box.
notes: The build is simulated on a timer. Replace generate with a call to your backend and feed the step states, times and streamed text from its events.

Picking a template chip replaces the description with that template's text. The address shows Available, Taken or a format hint as you type, announced politely to screen readers. The progress card moves under the form below 1280px.
